name: Bottom-up Octree Construction
definition: A bottom-up algorithm to construct an adaptive-resolution octree from a 3D scalar array, consolidating homogeneous voxels to compress data and building a min/max tree for acceleration.
summary: Bottom-up octree construction is a fast, single-pass spatial compression technique that recursively fuses neighboring voxels into an adaptive-resolution octree, distinguishing itself by visiting each voxel exactly once unlike top-down methods.
